contract_plain_english: In the proof of Hoeffding's inequality, fix one index i from 1 through N and retain the already fixed lambda > 0 [E3,E4,E5]. Because X_i is Rademacher, it equals 1 and -1 with probability 1/2 each, so its exponential moment is exactly E exp(lambda a_i X_i) = (exp(lambda a_i)+exp(-lambda a_i))/2, and that same average is exactly cosh(lambda a_i) [E1,E5]. Both equalities are part of the selected claim [E5]. Independence is used just before this passage to factor the MGF of the sum, while the theorem's t and the proof's normalization ||a||_2=1 do not participate in this single-factor calculation [E2,E3,E4,E5].
